items.theme: `skills/beacon/SKILL.md` 被收敛成更明确的 meta-protocol
items.text: Beacon converges `skills/beacon/SKILL.md` into a compact meta-protocol that prioritizes decision-surface classification, persistent global rules, route-back rules, and support-surface advisory boundaries over wrapper/manual sprawl.

items.theme: `using-beacon` 能稳定表达 truth/execution/verification/gate/support 的路由宪法
items.text: Beacon converges `skills/beacon/using-beacon/SKILL.md` into the host-native route constitution for truth, execution, verification, gate, and support decisions, with explicit route reasoning and `change` escalation when support output alters accepted scope.

items.theme: 第一批横向工程 support skills 被正式定义并保持 support-only 边界
items.text: Beacon introduces a first-wave horizontal engineering support skill family that at minimum defines `beacon-context-engineering`, `beacon-source-driven`, and `beacon-doubt-review`, and each remains a support surface rather than a new lifecycle stage.

items.theme: 第一批 lightweight references 被正式引入并可被关键 surfaces 引用
items.text: Beacon freezes the rule that newly added horizontal engineering support skills are non-truth, non-gate, and route back to canonical truth or delivery surfaces when they detect scope, promise, or acceptance drift.

items.theme: 文档中存在 external lifecycle / Beacon lifecycle 的清晰映射
items.text: Beacon adds a first-wave lightweight reference package for human-readable operator support, including requirement/research/freeze/QA/release/routing references, and those references are explicitly non-canonical supporting material.

items.theme: support surfaces 的 specialist packaging 提升，但 public main chain 未扩张
items.text: Beacon documents a stable lifecycle mapping that explains how external engineering phase models such as `agent-skills` and specialist sprint models such as `gstack` map onto Beacon's own closure chain without changing Beacon's mainline.

items.theme: 多宿主、browser/session/tooling 能力对 operator 的可读性增强
items.text: Beacon improves specialist packaging for support surfaces so users can understand what kind of challenge, review, or strengthening a surface provides without Beacon becoming a flat catalog of dozens of public commands.

items.theme: learning 与 route explainability 对人类更清楚，但 truth/gate separation 不被削弱
items.text: Beacon improves host/operator readability around multi-host use and browser/session/tooling reality, but treats those as support/readability improvements rather than new lifecycle stages or runtime prerequisites.

Beacon improves human-readable learning and route explainability so operators can tell which route recommendation comes from frozen truth, which parts are learning hints, and which surfaces remain advisory only.

v1.4.7 preserves Beacon's root-preservation rules: compact main chain, support surfaces remain non-stage, truth stays canonical and versioned, QA/release stay fail-closed, and skill defaults remain philosophy + minimum tools + necessary facts instead of rigid scripts.
